# Quizard

> Turn your PDF, PPTX, DOCX or text documents into exam-style practice quizzes.

## Product

Quizard is a document-to-quiz study PWA: import a document and it extracts the text in the browser, then generates exam-style multiple-choice questions — four options per question with a direct, document-grounded stem.

- [App homepage](https://quizard-app.github.io/)
- [PWA manifest](https://quizard-app.github.io/manifest.webmanifest)

## Tech notes

- Angular + Ionic PWA. Documents, scores and settings stay in the browser (IndexedDB + localStorage).
- AI question writing, answer explanations and the wizard voice run through the built-in Cloudflare relay (`relay/`), or a personal Gemini key saved in Settings. Without either, the app still generates questions with its own engine.
- Source repository: [github.com/quizard-app/quizard-app.github.io](https://github.com/quizard-app/quizard-app.github.io)
